about: Hand-picked. The only verses shown when a query names a sensitive topic (sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and pregnancy loss, disability, race, religion or none, caste, eating and body image). Chosen from pool verses still marked universal after the reviews: they affirm dignity, being known, not being forsaken, compassion and comfort. None is tagged guilt_repentance, temptation_self_control, forgiveness, family_parents, marriage or illness, and none has womb, breastfeeding, body or gender words, 'straight', a healing promise, sin, repent or cleanse wording, or creed-specific wording. Results are ranked within this list by the normal scorer. The Gita has only six: most of its universal verses teach detachment from desire, likes and dislikes, or evenness in dishonour, which read badly after such a disclosure, and its verses of being held and loved speak as Krishna ('Me') and so are not universal.

gita.why: No sincere effort is lost, and a little understanding guards against great fear.
Words should not hurt: truthful, pleasant and helpful speech.
Clear understanding knows what to fear and what not to fear.

quran.why: Wherever you turn, God is there: no one is out of reach.
God as protector and best of helpers.
Not a leaf falls unknown: being fully known.
Every child of Adam has been honoured: human dignity for all.
A short prayer to relieve a troubled mind.
Fear not; I am with you, hearing and seeing.
Not alone: 'my Lord is with me; He will guide me.'
Trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
Favour is meant for those who were oppressed.
An honest prayer of need after helping others.
God is enough to rely on.
Saving rain after despair: mercy spread out.
God is with you wherever you are.
Whoever trusts in God, He is enough for them.
Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor does He hate you.

bible.why: You will not be failed or forsaken; do not fear.
Be strong and of good courage: you are not alone wherever you go.
A stranger living among you is not to be mistreated.
A refuge for the oppressed in times of trouble.
Darkness will be lit up.
A prayer for mercy when you feel desolate and afflicted.
A prayer not to be forsaken or left far away.
A refuge and strength, a present help in trouble.
Every tear is seen and kept.
Pour out your heart: there is refuge.
Comfort when your thoughts crowd in.
You are searched and known.
There is nowhere you could go to be out of reach.
How precious are God's thoughts toward you.
Good to all, with mercy over everything made.
Those who fall are upheld and those bowed down are lifted.
Fear not, you are not alone; you will be strengthened and upheld.
Mountains may move, but kindness will not depart from you.
Loved with an everlasting love.
Those who mourn will be comforted.
Not one sparrow is forgotten.
God shows no partiality between people.
Weep with those who weep.
